t: When you are making excuses to yourself
a: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
p: Bali-l-insānu ʿalā nafsihi baṣīrah, wa law alqā maʿādhīrah.
m: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness, Even if he presents his excuses.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
